text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, at Rhein Kraft's recommendation, 
I came out to sunbathe for a change of 
pace, but—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Hyaa! So bright! The sun sure is full of 
energy today!
choice_data_list:
The sun's a bit too harsh for just taking 
a breather...

The sun's a bit too strong for taking a 
break, isn't it...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
It might be hard to refresh yourself like 
this. In that case...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
The restaurant on the edge of town has a 
terrace, but their lunch service is 
already over... The northern bamboo 
grove's caretaker is away today, too—
choice_data_list: C-Craft...?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I found it! Let's go together, 
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Mmmh~! So nice~~. Intense sunlight is best 
enjoyed through a windowpane, after all.
choice_data_list:
Where did you find a swimsuit and 
sunglasses?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Where, you ask? ...In my bag, of course! 
Sunbathing items are an absolute 
necessity!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
With that resort vibe, it adds an extra 
touch of refreshment! It doubles the fun 
of sunbathing, too!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Hum-hum-dee-hum. Let's stay all cozy and 
warm like this until sundown~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Ping ♪)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ah, an approaching rain cloud alert...! 
Looks like it's coming from the 
south-southwest.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"...Trainer, I'll change quickly! Let's 
head out!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After changing her clothes, Rhein Kraft 
dashed out into the rain for some 
reason...
choice_data_list: Where are you planning to go!?
Where do you plan on going!?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Of course! Only up until where the sky is 
clear!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Alright, it should be around here...
choice_data_list: Thank goodness, it's not raining!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"Huh...? This isn't our destination, you 
know."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Um, could you take us out to that island 
offshore?

text_block_list.name: Fisherman
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's you again, young lady! Alrighty, 
leave it to me!
choice_data_list: 'Again'... Do you ride it all the time?
'Again'... Do you always ride it?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Yes! The deserted island just ahead is the 
perfect spot! Now's our chance while there 
are no rain clouds!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Basking in the sun, soaking up the rays~♪

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Gwaaaaaaah!?
choice_data_list: W-What's happening here?!
W-What's going on?!

text_block_list.name: Fisherman
text_block_list.text:
The weather turned real bad all of a 
sudden! We're heading back!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: N-No waaay~?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, we ultimately ended up back at a 
rainy Tracen Academy, but...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"Hmm, looks like there are no clouds at 
the mountain peak. But even if we leave 
now, the sun will go down—"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I'll try asking around a bit more. Please 
wait for me, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"She naturally has no intention of giving 
up. What is it that drives her this 
far...?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I hadn't probed too deeply into it before, 
but there might be a profound reason 
behind it.
choice_data_list: Hey, Craft...
Hey, Craft...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Yes? What is it?
choice_data_list:
Is there a deep reason behind your 
obsession with sunbathing?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: A deep reason... Yes, there is one.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: I—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: I absolutely, positively LOVE sunbathing!!
choice_data_list: Huh, I know that, but... i-is that all?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Yes! That's all!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To break through this far purely out of 
love... ...Considering her obsession with 
the Tiara, it's certainly very fitting of 
Rhein Kraft.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Ah, I wonder if it'll clear up soon~?
choice_data_list:
Yeah, I want to get out into the sun soon 
too!

Yeah, I want to get some sunshine soon 
too!

Let's wait here until the weather clears 
up.
Want to hang up a teru teru bozu together?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Ah, I wonder if it'll clear up soon~?
choice_data_list:
Yeah, I want to get out into the sun soon 
too!

Yeah, I want to get some sunshine soon 
too!

Let's wait here until the weather clears 
up.
Want to hang up a teru teru bozu together?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Right! You're one of us now, Trainer-san♪

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Then let's get our rematch tomorrow! How 
about in front of the school gates at 
sunrise?!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I'll bring the hammocks and stuff! You 
can come empty-handed, it's totally fine!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, let's enjoy it to the absolute 
fullest~.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
You're right... I'll trust in the 
weather's whims and wait it out!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"If you want to work, go right ahead! I'm 
just going to take it easy and wait for 
the rain to stop."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Hmm hum hum♪

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"Waiting for the sun like, 'Is it coming 
yet, is it coming yet?' Even this time is 
so much fun, isn't it? ♪"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: I think that's a fantastic idea!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you don't need tissues or pens, so 
don't worry!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I have spares in my locker! I'll go grab 
them~.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
...It's to cover the entire window, so 
maybe about a hundred would be enough.
